# Download

##### Applications

Enjoy quick access and easier notifications with dedicated desktop and mobile apps.

[Download for Windows](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9ph1pknxz54p) [Download for Android](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.guildsofwow.twa) PWA INSTALLATION READY

* * *

FOR GUILD MANAGERS

* * *

##### Sync App / In-Game Addon

Sync app is the desktop application and in-game addon for event and recruitment synchronization.

* Sync app is Guilds of WoW desktop application for allowing synchronization of GoW data to WoW and vice versa. Blizzard doesn't provide any event and recruitment API so this application needs to be installed for integration.
* It automatically installs and updates in-game addon without the need of any addon manager.
* You can create events on in-game calendar. Addon invites all players with the rules or the audience defined on GoW.
All RSVPs from GoW and in the game synchronize bidirectionally.
* You can view guild teams and invite team roster to your party.
* You can view recruitment applications and invite, add as friend or whisper easily.
* Migrates guild ranks, message of the day and character/officer notes back to Guilds of WoW.
* You can sync back your guild's Mythic+ keystones to GoW and Discord (Requires 'Astral Keys' and/or 'Details' addons).

[Install Sync App](https://guildsofwow.com/addon) x64 & ARM APPLE SILICON

GoW Sync App

##### Discord Bot

The Guilds of WoW Discord Bot brings your events and combat logs seamlessly to your Discord server.

* Event attendance is synced periodically to keep everything up to date.
* Bind recurring events to specific channels for easy organization.
* Players can select their attendance via Discord, syncing directly with GoW and WoW (if the in-game addon is set up).
